cases.title: Published Stages table shows the correct columns and values
steps: Review the table headers and stage row.
cases.expected: The Stage Code column is not shown because no row has ref_id. Stage Title and Pending Actions are shown. Participants shows the active/total value, using 0 for missing values. Bidding Starts At and Bidding Ends At show DATE_TIME values.
cases.setup: Use a project with one published stage, no stage row with ref_id, missing participant totals, and configured start and end dates.
gaps: The prepared project has two published stages, not the requested one, and catalog steps cannot configure this fixed fixture to ensure every stage lacks ref_id.
The prepared fixture does not provide missing participant totals, so the active/total fallback to 0 cannot be tested.
No catalog assertion compares stage start and end dates with their API values or validates DATE_TIME formatting; expected date strings were not supplied.

steps.note: Check the requested column absence; the no-ref_id fixture premise remains unverified.
Verify the stage-title column is displayed.
Verify the pending-actions column is displayed.
Verify the participant column is displayed, without claiming its missing-value fallback was tested.
Verify the start-date column is displayed.
Verify the end-date column is displayed.
Record row values for manual review; this does not assert participant fallback or date formatting.

cases.title: Line Items and Participants counts match response data
steps: Review the Line Items and Participants panel headers.
cases.expected: The headers show Line Items 0 and Participants 1.
cases.setup: Use a project whose line-item response count is 0 and participant response count is 1.
gaps: Verify Line Items 0 for a project with a zero-count line-item response: the fixed prepared event has one line item, not zero.

plan.title: Project panel counts match response data

steps.note: Open the prepared project's details screen.
Check the header against the available one-line-item fixture; this does not test the requested zero-count state.
Verify the participant header matches the response count of one.

cases.title: Search participants is debounced and limits results to 20
steps: Enter a partial vendor name in "Search participants".
Wait at least 300 milliseconds after the final keystroke.
Review the participant results using Vendor Name and Vendor Code.
cases.expected: Only one search is applied after the final keystroke. Matching participant results are shown, with no more than 20 results on the page.
cases.setup: Use a project with more than 20 participants and at least two participants whose Vendor Name or Vendor Code contains the same search text.
gaps: Provide more than 20 participants, including two whose Vendor Name or Vendor Code contains the same search text, in the fixed prepared state.
Continue typing within 300 milliseconds and wait at least 300 milliseconds after the final keystroke with controlled timing.
Assert that exactly one search is applied after the final keystroke.
Verify matching Vendor Name or Vendor Code results and the 20-result limit against a sufficiently large participant dataset.

cases.title: Invalid project-details tab renders no content
cases.expected: With the unsupported tabKey, no project-detail panel is rendered. The valid tabs remain available and render their corresponding content when selected.
cases.setup: Open the project details URL with a tabKey that is not details, master_qcs, or a valid stage UUID.
gaps: Navigate to the prepared event's project-details URL with an unsupported tabKey: no project ID is supplied and no catalog step constructs that URL from the current event.
Assert that no project-detail panel renders for the unsupported tabKey, then verify recovery from that state through each valid tab.
